text: In the legal domain the adoption of transformer based language models is blocked less by capability than by resources and access: training and deployment are resource intensive and large, quality tagged legal datasets are usually restricted.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4855607

isBasedOn.name: How AI Models are Optimized Through Web3 Governance

abstract: In the legal domain, training and deploying Transformer-based Language Models (TLMs) is resource-intensive, and access to large, quality-tagged legal datasets is often restricted, hindering widespread adoption.
